title: Scheduled Payments: Complete Guide
summary: This document explains how to schedule Scheduled Payments, including limits of 30 maximum active schedules, at least 4 days between occurrences, up to $3,000 per payment, and 3 days advance notification before each charge. It covers rules for adjusting cadence, managing/ canceling schedules when at 30, and verifying reminders and post-payment confirmation.
faqs: What are the maximum limits for Scheduled Payments (active schedules, days between occurrences, and per-payment amount)?
How many days in advance will I get notified before a scheduled payment is charged?
What scheduling rules must I follow to avoid errors (e.g., spacing between occurrences and amount limits)?
What should I do if I already have 30 active schedules and want to add another?
How do I review and manage active schedules to confirm dates and amounts?
After a scheduled payment processes, what should I verify in my activity?
